title: Factory data integration
subtitle: Staged rows, master data and import history — Factory 360 profiles are view only

banner.title: Settings only.
banner.body: Factory 360 pages are read only. Adding a provider does not mean it is connected. Rows from a file wait until someone approves them. Source numbers cannot be changed quietly.

provider.title: Senaei provider
provider.noRemoteCall: No remote call is made from this page. Undocumented provider domains remain SENAEI_API_CONTRACT_NOT_SUPPLIED.
provider.help: The agreed connection and its recorded live-call check are shown in SENAI data management. Adding one does not mean it is connected.

csv.title: CSV staging and validation
csv.schemaNote: File format {schema}. Required identity columns: {required}. Files wait to be matched. This action never overwrites factory records.
csv.staged: Batch {batch} is waiting. {pending} rows still to match, {rejected} rejected with safe errors. No row is accepted until someone approves the match.

masterData.title: Factory master-data controls
masterData.help: These operations are always recorded in the Activity Log. They do not edit external CR, license, or plant identifiers.
masterData.noWriteback: View only — nothing is sent back.
masterData.noWritebackHelp: What you save here stays in this app. Nothing is sent back to SENAI. There is no agreed way to write factory records there.
masterData.factoriesError: The factory list could not be read. Import and matching history below may still be available.
masterData.representativesError: Representatives could not be read for this factory. Other factory facts remain available.

status.title: Representative status
status.empty: No representatives are recorded for this factory.

history.title: Sync and import history
history.runsError: Sync runs could not be read. Rejected rows and matching records remain independently readable below.
history.batchesError: Batch tracking details could not be read. Available sync-run facts are kept without a guessed file origin.
history.emptyBody: You cannot see any update or import runs. We checked — there are none.

rejected.title: Rejected staged rows
rejected.error: Rejected staged rows could not be read. This is data that's not available, not an empty rejection set.
rejected.emptyBody: No rejected staged rows. This is a checked, empty result.

reconciliation.title: Matching history
reconciliation.error: Matching history could not be read. This is data that's not available, not an empty history.
reconciliation.emptyBody: You cannot see any matching records. We checked — there are none. Staged does not mean imported.
